mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior month, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 1.5% for three consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 1.5% for 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and decline in the unemployment rate signals a tightening monetary policy amid a strong labor market, which compresses equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tightening cycle with strong labor market
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02 over 3 years.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in housing starts below 1.1 million units signals weakening consumer demand, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of late-cycle expansion periods when HOUST declines below 1.1 million, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls above 150,000 jobs signals robust labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS increases above 150,000, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for 2 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index above 105.0 signals strong manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 105.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP growth (annualized) falls below 1.5% for two consecutive quarters, it signals a weakening economic cycle that reduces corporate revenue growth expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when GDPC1 falls below 1.5% annualized for two quarters, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.02.
